name: Mathematics
prose: `$…$`/`\(…\)` inline and `$$…$$`/`\[…\]` display LaTeX render as native **MathML**: no library, no CDN, no extra web font, and nothing the strict CSP has to be relaxed for. Symbols, sub/superscripts, fractions, roots, big operators with limits, delimiters, text runs and matrix/cases environments; anything unparsed falls back to its own source. Prices (`$5, not $7`) and backticked `` `$x$` `` stay text.
invariant: Inline and display LaTeX render as native MathML with no library, no CDN and nothing the strict CSP must relax; anything unparsed falls back to its source.
